target: The financial bank has money.
note: Swaps holder and item; the financial bank would be held by money.

target: The boat reaches the river bank.
note: Changes the destination from riverbank to a financial institution.

target: The light is bright.
note: Changes the word light from illumination to low weight.

target: A person presses a keyboard key.
note: Changes who presses whom, reversing actor and object roles.

target: A biological cell divides.
note: Changes biological cell to an electric cell.

target: An electric cell has stored energy.
note: Swaps the cell that holds energy with the energy being held.

target: If the gas is heated, the gas expands.
note: Reverses antecedent and consequent; heating is no longer the condition for expansion.

target: The instrument may fail.
note: Asserts actual failure rather than that failure is possible.

target: Every number equals itself.
note: Changes universal quantification into existential quantification.

target: At least one integer is greater than zero.
note: Changes greater-than to less-than, while keeping the same subject and zero.

target: Not every integer is positive.
note: Changes not-all-positive into all-not-positive; quantifier and negation scopes differ.

target: Two is less than three.
note: Swaps comparison operands, altering the inequality direction.

target: The computer mouse moves the cursor.
note: Reverses who moves what: the cursor now moves the mouse device.

target: A user has a security credential key.
note: Substitutes a physical door key for a digital credential.

target: A program checks a file before deleting the file.
correct: BEFORE(earlier=DO(actor=PROGRAM, action=CHECK, object=FILE), later=DO(actor=PROGRAM, action=DELETE, object=FILE))
foil: BEFORE(earlier=DO(actor=PROGRAM, action=DELETE, object=FILE), later=DO(actor=PROGRAM, action=CHECK, object=FILE))
note: Changes the sequence from checking before deleting to deleting before checking.

target: The server may fail.
note: Replaces possible failure with an asserted failure.

target: A financial bank lends money.
note: Substitutes a riverbank for a financial bank.

target: A court protects a legal right.
note: Changes legal entitlement to a spatial direction.

target: A store charges a fee.
note: Changes the action from charging a fee to electric charging.

target: Some people have land.
note: Changes some people having land into all people having land.

target: A physical model represents a building.
note: Changes a physical scale model into a statistical model.

target: An expert says that a report is false.
note: Removes the negation of the report truth value.

target: Every researcher believes the same claim.
note: Changes every researcher into at least one researcher.

target: An observer knows that an instrument measures a system.
note: Replaces a knowledge attribution with a belief attribution.
